description: This Java source file defines the ClassInfo class, which models metadata about a Java class or interface, including its fields, methods, inheritance hierarchy, and attributes like whether it's an enum or annotation. It also includes functionality for flattening class hierarchies and normalizing type names.

classes.name: ClassInfo
classes.description: Represents Java class or interface metadata, including fields, methods, inheritance info, and attributes such as enum or annotation status. Provides methods to manage class information and perform hierarchy flattening.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class.

methods.name: getSuperclassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the superclass.

methods.name: getStatic
methods.description: Returns the 'static' attribute indicating if the class is static, not static, or unknown.

methods.name: isEnum
methods.description: Checks if the class is an enumerated type.

methods.name: isAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if the class is an annotation type.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to the class metadata.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a field by name and type.

methods.name: getFieldIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all fields.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Adds a method to the class metadata.

methods.name: getMethodIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all methods.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a method by its name and descriptor.

methods.name: getMethodIgnoringReturn
methods.description: Retrieves a method ignoring the return type part of the descriptor, useful for methods with covariant return types.

methods.name: hasNoFieldMethod
methods.description: Checks if the class has no fields and methods.

methods.name: addInterface
methods.description: Adds an interface name to the list of interfaces implemented by this class.

methods.name: flattenClass
methods.description: Flattens the class hierarchy by copying all methods and fields from superclasses and interfaces into this class's metadata, also detects if it's an enum or annotation.

methods.name: normalizeTypes
methods.description: Normalizes type names in fields and methods to their canonical forms.

methods.name: mergeFrom
methods.description: Merges fields and methods from another ClassInfo into this one.

methods.name: lookupClass
methods.description: Looks up a class by its fully qualified name within an ApiList hierarchy.
